nonblocking_findings: C4-1 [Minor] review-c: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:109-112 and plan.md:95: Plan line 95 says the nav of each page gets the links `Real work` and `Review` after `Results`. The preview adds them to index.html only (preview.sh python step, index_path block). The pages methodology.html, results.html, tracks.html, and the 19 pages under models/ keep the old nav (grep of `Results` in docs/ shows no other link). After a publish, a user on the Results page has no link to Real work. In Phase 1 the `Review` link also points to review.html, which no task before 4.8 writes: the link is dead in the preview. Fix: state in plan.md that the link set on the other pages and the Review link wait for a named later task, or apply the same idempotent insert to every docs page that holds a `Results` link (use `../` in models/). By code trace; the sandbox blocked a preview.sh probe.

C4-2 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:119-122 and :138: The python block imports hashlib, html, json, and os, but sha256_file calls `sys.exit(2)` (line 138). The name `sys` is not defined, so that branch raises NameError, not the refusal line `preview: unreadable <path>`. The branch is dead for a dangling link (the shell check at :103 runs first). An unreadable file (mode 000) under docs/ fails earlier at `cp -a` (:112): exit 1 with a cp message, after `mkdir -p` (:109), so a half-copied preview folder stays. The header (lines 7-11) names only the dangling case, and test B2-1 covers only a dangling link for preview.sh (preview-gate.test.ts:1076-1083). Add `import sys`, or remove the branch. Optionally check readability in the shell before the mkdir. By code trace.

C4-3 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide-tests/preview-gate.test.ts:1014-1027: The test A3-3 checks exit 2, an unchanged docs snapshot, and one non-empty stdout line. It does not pin the line `preview: refused path <link path>` that the header of preview.sh (lines 8-10) and plan.md F3 state. A wrong text would pass. The header block of the test file (line 44) lists only the `<value>` form. Add an exact stdout check with the absolute link path.

C4-4 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/pages/real-work.html:106-108 and .tmp/model-guide-preview/real-work.html: The card `Print audit` shows a heading and no content in Phase 1, because the token is replaced with an empty string (preview.sh python step). FR-5 forbids a placeholder line and the block belongs to a later phase, so the empty card is a known gap. A reader sees an empty section in the preview. Hide the card until the data file exists, or accept it for the preview only.

Docs has no symlink today (find docs -type l printed nothing), so the first preview never plants a link that the second run refuses. The line text is untested (C4-3).
